//Serilog: Levels only. Sinks are configured in code because they differ by environment in a way a settings file expresses badly.
//RabbitMq: Credentials are deliberately absent. Supply them per environment through RabbitMq__UserName and RabbitMq__Password, user-secrets, or the compose file.
//Retention: ProcessedMessagePeriod is a correctness setting: a marker deleted while the broker could still redeliver its message turns at-least-once into twice.
//OpenTelemetry: Traces and metrics are always produced. They are only exported when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set; metrics are on /metrics regardless.
//StatusSimulator: Demo traffic. Off everywhere by default; switch on for a walkthrough.
